name: Miso-Hoisin Rice Noodles with Chicken, Bok Choy & Bell Pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water is boiling, remove from heat and add the rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 baby bok choy
1 ½ red bell peppers
6 sticks celery

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, chicken, miso paste, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until cooked through and the veggies are tender, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
0.68 kg ground chicken
3 tbsp miso paste, red
1 ½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add drained noodles and hoisin sauce to the pot. Continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until noodles and sauce are warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide saucy noodles, chicken, and veggies between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
